methodology.query_selection: A deterministic 20% stratified sample by fraud_type from the persisted historical case records.
methodology.query_input: The saved description for each selected case.
methodology.retrieval: The existing SimilarCaseService with the persisted MiniLM FAISS index; the query case itself is removed before scoring.
methodology.relevance: A retrieved case is relevant when its fraud_type matches the query case fraud_type.
methodology.metrics: Hit@1, Hit@3, Hit@5, and mean reciprocal rank (MRR).
